thread:
alex_sales: Quick help please  PolarTech POC is blocked. Their calls to /generate return 403 with 'invalid_project_claim'. They say the key in their secrets manager is 'active'. Can eng triage?

devx_julie: Can you paste the exact curl and the raw error (include request_id if available)?

alex_sales: Customer sent this snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_pt_42' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: polartech' \\
  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: workshop' \\
  -d '{"model":"rw/gpt-9b","input":"hello"}'```
Raw response: `{"error":"invalid_project_claim","status":403,"hint":"jwt project claim=workshop-prod != header workshop" , "request_id":"req-PT-2026-900"}`

ron_eng: Hint shows JWT claim is workshop-prod but header is workshop. Most often this means the app is using a key issued for a different project (old/stale key or CI secret mixup).

alex_sales: They insist they copied the key from the project's key page. They use HashiVault and k8s.

devx_julie: Quick fixes: 1) Rotate/create a new project-scoped key: Console -> Projects -> workshop -> Keys -> Create, update secret in Vault, restart pods. 2) Temporary workaround: remove X-Redwood-Project header so gateway falls back to token claim (only OK for single-project tests). Recommend rotation for POC.

ops_tom: Note we tightened enforcement recently; keys created before policy v2 may be global/shadow and will 403 if header mismatches. If they can't rotate now we can apply a short-lived routing exception for tenant_id but that needs change-control and ~2 hours.

alex_sales: They also reported intermittent 429s when demo retries happened. If we fix the 403 and they replay queued requests we could trigger rate limits. Any quick quota we can offer?

ops_tom: For demos we can bump project quota: burst=60 and steady=6 rps for 24h. I'll apply and log it in the ticket. Ask them to enable exponential backoff.

ron_eng: If rotation is done and issue persists, ask them to paste only JWT header+payload (redact signature) or give request_id and we decode server-side. DO NOT paste private keys. Also check CI pipelines for cached env vars.

devx_julie: Dev snippet to share: ensure Authorization token and X-Redwood headers align. Example: ```js
fetch(url, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_...', 'X-Redwood-Org': 'polartech', 'X-Redwood-Project': 'workshop-prod' } })
```

alex_sales: I've opened ticket and captured request_id=req-PT-2026-900. I'll tell them to rotate the key, update Vault, restart workloads, and hold off on replaying failed requests.

support-bot: support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-788 created for request_id=req-PT-2026-900, assigned to eng-triage.

ron_eng: Also capture the JWT payload if they canit will speed things up. If they want sustained capacity we should propose a 30-day Dedicated trial so they don't hit quota during demos.

alex_sales: Good plan. I'll coordinate rotation and quote the Dedicated trial if they ask. Will update this thread with the new curl after they swap keys. Thanks team :thumbsup:
